products.title: False Reap Accusations by Craig Jones
products.body:
Learn The Intracacies Of The False Reap With B-Team Co-Founder & Grappling Great Craig Jones’s Guide To This Popular & Effective Leg Locking Entry
  • See how to use the false reap to enter into leg locks from tons of popular no-gi guards like the z guard, pendejo guard, and more
  • Craig Jones is one of grappling’s most popular figures and a co-founder of the B-Team, with tons of elite experience using these techniques
  • Use variations like the falsanari, false reap assimilation, and more to create lots of unique leg locking opportunities
  • Finish more submissions on the lower body as Craig teaches you ways to set up kneebars, heel hooks, and more from the false reap

products.title: Craig Jones Mini Product The Reach Around AKA Octopus Guard by Craig Jones
products.body:
Turn The Tables On The Opposition With 2-Time ADCC Finalist & Grappling Star Craig Jones’s Brand New System For Creating Scrambles You Can’t Lose With The Reach Around Octopus Guard - A Position You Can Start Using For Reversals, Escapes, And Much More
  • Learn from one of grappling’s most in-demand instructors as elite competitor and B-Team co-founder Craig Jones shows this unique grappling offense
  • The octopus guard will let you set up reversals, scrambles, and more - by swimming your arm around your opponent with Craig’s careful advice
  • See how you can beat common counters and responses, like the cross face, stepping over, and opponents trying to get height
  • Use highly effective techniques to score and control opponents, including kosoto sweeps, butterfly sweeps, front headlocks, and more
  • Find ways to set up fight-ending submission locks, even the dreaded Buggy Choke and Craig’s innovative “Buggy Darce”

products.title: The B Team Top Game: How to Work Against Seated Guards, Supine Guards, and Those Trying to Stand Up by Craig Jones
products.body:
Learn the B-Team top game, including how to work against seated guards, supine guards, and those trying to stand up 

  • Force errors and exploit common mistakes with Craig’s techniques for passing - including stacks, torreandos, leg drags, and more
  • See some of the best ways to clear out of dangerous leg entanglements with leg locking master Craig’s advice
  • Craig is one of the most popular instructors in the world, with ADCC Medals & sustained elite competition success
  • This six-part series will help you understand how to approach and think about playing top in no-gi, and how you can begin to enforce your rhythm and method against your opponents

Redefine No-Gi Guard Passing With Australian Grappling Superstar Craig Jones As He Explains His System For Passing Against Tough Guards And Disengaging Dangerous Positions


What Will You Learn?

See your top game get better than ever with no-gi grappling star Craig Jones’s six-part series on guard passing concepts and techniques that you can use to better your skills. With coaching on how to break down the guard, including how he approaches seated guard, supine guard, and opponents determined to stand up, Craig shows a complete guard passing class for grapplers of all levels.

Use conceptual lessons like how to score your passes through fatigue, and how important the hip pocket is to every pass, as Craig shows you ways to make guard passing a lot simpler through easy adjustments. With drills and techniques built on a strong base of experience in competition against the best, Craig can show you what really works when you want to get to a dominant position and what mistakes people are commonly making.

Craig Jones is one of the most popular grapplers and instructors in the world, with an ADCC medal from 2019 and many elite victories against some of the best in the game. Use Craig’s coaching on leg drags, stacks, torreandos, body locks, and more as he shows you how to approach a dangerous guard and defuse the situation.

Don’t get caught up in those tricky leg entanglements again, Craig explains here on this six-volume series how to avoid those positions and even how to clear from dangerous positions like shin on shin and ashi garami. Combine your techniques into one system with Craig’s help as he shows you all the ways to shut down bottom fighters and be the power top on the mats.
